en.title: Longest AB String with Limited Runs
en.description:
Using at most countA A's and countB B's, with at most maxA consecutive A's and at most maxB consecutive B's, find the maximum length of a string you can construct. You need not use all the characters; a maximum run length of 0 for a letter means that letter cannot be used.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: One line containing countA countB maxA maxB, all four integers in 0..10^6.
en.explanation: The examples give 5, 2 and 0 respectively. In the first example, AABAA can be constructed.
hints: Handle the cases where a run limit is 0 first. Otherwise, if the A's exceed the capacity of the countB+1 slots provided by the B's, use only as many A's as the slots can hold; handle too many B's symmetrically; if neither is in excess, use them all.
